stdout:
Build kit for "theme"

Start from the TEMPLATE, fill it with BLOCKS, and use COMPONENTS only for what is left.
Changing a page you already have? Keep it, and use only the blocks and components.

TEMPLATE
The idea is a part of a page and names no page, so it starts from the app shell. Scaffold it, then put blocks inside it.

name:        shell-top-nav
package:     @astryxdesign/core
description: Application frame with horizontal navigation only: a centered bar whose items open full-width mega-menu panels, over placeholder content that keeps the entire width.
command:     npx @astryxdesign/cli@0.7.12 template shell-top-nav --type page <path>

Install missing dependencies: npm install @heroicons/react@"^2.2.0"

This template uses StyleX. Your project needs a StyleX compiler plugin - see `npx @astryxdesign/cli@0.7.12 docs styling-overview` for setup steps.

OTHER TEMPLATES
If the layout is wrong, scaffold one of these instead. All page templates: npx @astryxdesign/cli@0.7.12 template --list --type page

name:        theme-showcase
package:     @astryxdesign/core
description: Multi-surface comparison shell: preview palettes, typography, icons and control states across a storefront, checkout, chat and inventory on one responsive canvas.
command:     npx @astryxdesign/cli@0.7.12 template theme-showcase --type page <path>

BLOCKS
Ready-made sections for parts the template lacks (top 3 of 5; --verbose for all). Print one: npx @astryxdesign/cli@0.7.12 template <name>

name:        ThemeSwitcher
package:     @astryxdesign/core
description: Use state to switch the theme object passed to Theme and preview a different visual treatment.

name:        ThemeShowcase
package:     @astryxdesign/core
description: Two visually distinct theme providers wrapping identical content to show how Theme changes the visual treatment of child components.

name:        useThemeHookUsage
package:     @astryxdesign/core
description: Read resolved theme token values with useTheme for non-CSS consumers like SVG charts.

COMPONENTS
For what the template and blocks do not cover (top 3 of 4; --verbose for all). Read one: npx @astryxdesign/cli@0.7.12 component <name>

name:        Theme
package:     @astryxdesign/core
description: Wraps a subtree with a specific Astryx theme.

name:        MediaTheme
package:     @astryxdesign/core
description: Provides token overrides for content rendered on inverted surfaces: media overlays, scrims, toasts, and tooltips.

name:        useImageMode
package:     @astryxdesign/core
description: Detects whether an image is predominantly dark or light by sampling pixels via OffscreenCanvas.

frame:      AppShell, TopNav, SideNav, Layout
foundation: VStack, HStack, Grid, StackItem, Card, Section, Text, Heading, Button, Icon, Badge, Divider
